_comment: What a person can have switched on. `hub_kinds`: kinds of source they may subscribe to; `hub_ops`: other requests the hub accepts from them; `project`: the shared project installed in their stack by ops/project_sync.py (the stack must also be in that project's "stacks" list in the desktop's projects.json). Who has what is hubdata/modules.json, written only by ops/stack_modules.py.
